scope: Independent full exact encoded visual/narration review. Continuous soundwatch, Apple playback and publication remain separate.

lessons.reason: The exact movie materially constructs normalized queue identity, protected claims, TTL equality and copied-key deletion, dependency release, conserved quota, historical idempotency receipts, partial-acquisition cleanup, parser ownership and shared-clock worker schedules. Full delivered narration and every animation label family were read; all 22 authored sheets plus brand, three registered natives and ten extra native frames were personally viewed. All 339 registered artifacts and four current/frozen source pairs match. One hundred forty-nine fresh independent JS-helper/math/Canvas checks pass. The final prediction stays neutral, its 8-second and 5-second labels follow completed clauses and the dependency publication boundary is correct. No material visual or teaching blocker remains. Secondary worker-choice, contract/type and snapshot schematics have settled holds, and the final parent-merge payoff is brief.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Replay two absent reads and duplicate fetches, then retain one atomic claim and one skipped worker before fetching outside the lock.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The shared state, program counters and separate fetch receipts make the broken and repaired transitions inspectable.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Attach claim, deadline, retry attempt and effect key to one retained queue item, then shrink duplicate output to one check-and-insert transition.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The requirements become state belonging to distinct decisions; the second contract-scope beat is comparatively settled.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Move a FIFO head, build a priority heap and contrast frequency/recency owners, then count a concrete four-node five-edge graph.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The graph and heap costs remain distinct, with callback and string costs explicitly outside the local bounds.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Pop the original same-origin frontier, normalize fragments and skip duplicate discoveries without changing stable URL identity.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Actual normalized URL order and retained seen state agree with the exported helper and supplied callback order.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Split URL components, remove a default port and fragment, retain the query and reject credential/port/space/scheme cases before queue admission.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The local string boundary is visibly separate from DNS, redirects and address-policy enforcement.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Let the first worker insert the URL, make the second skip it, and keep fetching outside the short protected transition.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: One owner and one fetch are distinct from choosing which real thread wins.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Keep a possible A/B race outcome separate from the barrier guarantee, compare unordered completion with parent-order merge and retain a failed claim.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The failure and cancellation scope stays local; the three-second versus one-second worksheet is separately supplied.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Advance the injected clock from a live deadline boundary to equality, then remove the expired value.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: 14.999 seconds is live and 15 seconds is expired; zero TTL and absent value remain distinguishable.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Inspect copied keys at one clock sample, delete the expired row, replace an old deadline on permanent overwrite and retain an unread expired allocation.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The late table deliberately shows physical unread storage. Its next-read arrow describes a future operation, so retained bytes do not contradict the missing-value contract.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Execute missing-to-running and running-to-ready comparisons, then place expiration, comparison and replacement inside one proposed critical section.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Executed no-TTL scope and the proposed synchronized TTL extension are explicit; the final frozen-snapshot illustration is largely settled.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Pop priority work, fail test once, requeue it immediately and release deploy only after completion; then exhaust attempts and keep deploy blocked.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Retry attempt counts, executed order and failed versus blocked states agree with the actual fixed fixture.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Traverse an otherwise hidden cycle before any ready task runs, compare priority/name tie breaking and reject a truthy string result.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The independent ready node has zero effects while the complete graph is invalid. The later retry/type comparison is a distinct construction.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Claim ready work, execute outside the protected state and publish success before decrementing the dependent count and notifying waiters.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Exact native frames retain remaining=1 before the completed publication clause and show remaining=0 with deploy ready afterward. The implementation is explicitly a proposed concurrent handoff.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Spend a three-token burst, deny the fourth request without debit and refill half and then one token on the injected clock.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The bar geometry, denied state and retry-after values match the conserved token ledger.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Keep a refilled token amount through denial, construct cost four beyond capacity three and compare unsafe immediate eviction with equivalent full refill.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The same capacity and refill rule produce different valid deletion times; an in-flight counter is kept separate.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Apply deposit and withdrawal, replay the original deposit result without resetting current balance and reject a changed payload under the same key.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: Historical return 100, current balance 70 and two retained events remain distinct in the exact native/sheet states.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Replay the historical receipt through later balance changes, distinguish Boolean and integer identity types and interrupt a three-field volatile update.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The crash point changes the main balance/event/result counts. Some identity/type explanatory states hold longer than their construction needs.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Deduplicate and sort shared lock IDs, acquire A inside an active ExitStack, fail the later Z lookup and unwind A before contrasting global key scope.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The native payoff shows A unlocked after KeyError. Fairness, durability and transaction semantics are not inferred from the lock order.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Move a current-record pointer through an orphan, header and continuation, clear it on malformed input and preserve message bars after two delimiters.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: A separate streaming-buffer proposal visibly retains split fragments while remaining distinct from the executed whole-text parser.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Match waiting and computation to worker choices, pass a serialized request/result with stable t7 identity and merge only in the parent.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The data exchange is meaningful; the worker-choice diagram is mostly a settled schematic.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Overlap supplied waits on one GIL CPU lane, copy a serialized parent list into worker-owned state and contrast yielding with blocking event order.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The parent list stays unchanged and lambda serialization failure is explicit. The optional runtime and measurement limits remain scoped.

reviewedScenes.mechanism: Hold two new wait/compute jobs, build serial and overlapping-wait schedules on one seconds scale and merge identified results in the parent.
reviewedScenes.deficiencyRemedy: The question remains neutral, serial 8 and overlapped 5 labels wait for completed clauses, and the final parent merge does become visible. The final merge payoff is brief.

inspectedTransformations.mechanism: The same shared URL produces two unsafe fetches, then one claim owner and one fetch with a skipped duplicate.
A copied key list survives removal of the expired row while the permanent replacement loses its old deadline.
Known A is acquired before unknown Z raises, then the active context visibly releases A.
A neutral two-job prediction becomes actual serial and overlapped-wait intervals on the same seconds scale, with separate completed result gates.
